newsitem.title: USA: Lexington Cty, S.C., approves $12.9 mln school GOs.
newsitem.headline: Lexington Cty, S.C., approves $12.9 mln school GOs.

text.p: Voters in South Carolina's Lexington County School District 3 approved a pair of general obligation bonds totaling $12.9 million, a school spokeswoman said Monday.
A $9.8 million bond issue for a new middle school was approved by a 3-1 margin, while the $3.1 million issue for a district auditorium was approved by a 2-1 margin in Saturday's referendum.
The projects will raise property taxes by $32 a year on a $50,000 home and $48 a year on a $75,000 home.
